target: Bind a signed local embedded-audit proof's head_sha to the commit an auditor actually examined, not a later 'evidence head' successor, and require the canonical AGENTS.md 9.1 packet proof bundle to exist at the PR head and agree with the signed proof on audited commit and controlling verdict identity.
invariants: SCOPE: scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py is the sole fail-closed acceptance engine for the signed-local-attestation route. This packet only widens what it verifies -- it must never weaken signature verification, allowed-signers trust, namespace binding, repository or PR identity, or the existing passing-verdict policy.

EVIDENCE: caught by an automated reviewer bot on PR #1235 (DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp): a signed proof named an AUDIT_EVIDENCE_HEAD commit (a4c9aef015..., which only added report files) as head_sha, instead of the commit an AGY audit actually examined (bbcd474a0f...). The diff-scope check (audited..PR-head touches only the proof dir) never inspected the evidence-head commit's own contents, so nothing verified it added ONLY report files and not something else.

NOT A NEW PRECEDENT REPAIR: the same evidence-head-as-head_sha pattern is already committed for PR #1224 (proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-1224/PROOF.json, head_sha=3fa5c8e97b998734205a2dbd42a282ff82625ce6, auditor examined 488e6b89773255ac08b915a2bc6ba6e489a33ce2). This packet does not retroactively repair or invalidate that proof's substantive audit -- see the separate PR #1224 proof-binding-refresh follow-up.

PACKET_ID MUST BE SCHEMA-DERIVED: the allowed second directory (proof/<PACKET_ID>/) must be derived from the trusted schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json report_path pattern -- never from a separate, independently-trusted field an attacker could point anywhere.

TWO PROOFS MUST AGREE, NOT MERELY COEXIST: requiring the canonical packet bundle to exist is not sufficient by itself -- its own PROOF.json must declare the same audited head_sha and the same status/auditor_tool/auditor_model as the signed PR proof, or a packet bundle for an unrelated audit could sit alongside a false signed proof.

SINGLE POLICY ENGINE: schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json remains the only authority on embedded_audit shape. The packet-proof's embedded_audit object is validated against the same schema+policy path as the signed PR proof's, not a second hand-written check.
NO RETROACTIVE HISTORY REWRITE: existing merged proofs (e.g. PR #1224) are not amended by this packet. Any consequence for them is a separate, explicitly-scoped follow-up.

commit.message: fix(audit): bind local-attestation head_sha to the actually-audited commit and require the canonical packet proof bundle to agree with it

pr.title: fix(audit): bind signed local-attestation head_sha to the actually-audited commit
pr.body: Closes a gap an automated reviewer caught on PR #1235: a signed local embedded-audit proof could name an evidence-head successor (which only adds report files) as head_sha instead of the commit an auditor actually examined, so the diff-scope check never inspected that successor's own contents. head_sha must now be the real audited commit; the diff-scope allow-list widens to include proof/<PACKET_ID>/ (derived fail-closed from the schema-validated report_path) alongside the existing proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/, so the AGENTS.md 9.1 canonical packet bundle can land in the same delta -- but the bundle must now actually exist at the PR head and its own PROOF.json must agree with the signed proof on audited SHA and controlling verdict identity.

steps.task: Repair scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py: derive PACKET_ID fail-closed from the schema-validated report_path; widen the diff-scope allow-list to proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<N>/ and proof/<PACKET_ID>/; require proof/<PACKET_ID>/PROOF.json, the report_path file, and a non-empty proof/<PACKET_ID>/review_bundle/ to exist at the enforced PR head; require the packet PROOF.json's head_sha and embedded_audit status/auditor_tool/auditor_model to agree with the signed PR proof.

Update tests/audit/test_local_audit_acceptance.py fixture to build a canonical packet bundle by default, and add regression coverage: evidence-head masquerading as audited SHA -> FAIL; canonical packet proof successor + PR proof successor -> PASS; missing packet PROOF.json -> FAIL; missing/empty review_bundle -> FAIL; missing packet report -> FAIL; post-audit non-proof path -> FAIL; wrong packet directory -> FAIL; packet/PR proof head_sha or verdict-identity mismatch -> FAIL; head mismatch -> FAIL.
Independent different-family/runtime L3 audit against the exact substantive head (code + tests only, no post-audit proof artifacts).

Canonical packet proof bundle (proof/TP-DMX-LOCAL-AUDIT-PROOF-BINDING-001/{PROOF.json,AUDITOR_REPORT.md,review_bundle/}) as a proof-only successor, then signed pr_merge PROOF.json with head_sha = the actual audited commit.
Fresh exact-head CI + PR Steward. Stop for operator merge decision -- do not merge.
